messages:
kevin: Heads-up — we need an urgent minimal patch for 1.9.5. Regression in tokenization causing duplicate tokens in embeddings. Planning a tiny cherrypick-only hotfix. Cutoff target 11:30 PT. Who can own cherrypick + CI?

maria: I can own the cherrypicks. aiming to open PRs by 11:00. prefer cut at 11:20 if folks can review fast.

ajay: I can run the smoke and perf checks once the PRs are up. need the commit SHAs.

release-bot: Release window opened: release/1.9.x-hotpatch. Tags allowed: patch. Allowed changes: cherrypicks, test fixes.

sara: @maria I'll do the changelog blurb + release notes. Please drop PR links here when ready.

maria: PRs created: #2323 (tokenization — restore correct split behavior), #2330 (test tweak to avoid flaky timing). Both are cherrypicks from main -> release/1.9.x-hotpatch. Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/2323 , https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/2330

ajay: Running local smoke:
```
make smoke TESTS=token-dedupe
# watching logs: tail -f ./build/smoke.log
```

kevin: Keep diffs minimal — no new flags, no schema changes, no config changes. If either PR touches runtime kernels, call it out.

oliver: Looping in eng-sre for canary monitoring and rollback hooks. @eng-sre-bot can you standby for the deploy?

eng-sre-bot: Canary monitors subscribed to #infra-alerts. Will monitor latency and error-rate for 10m post-deploy. Auto-roll back threshold: 2% error increase or 200ms p50 regression.

maria: Pushed cherrypick branch: `maria/release-1.9.5-cherrypicks`. PR titles: "cherry-pick: token fix (release/1.9.x-hotpatch)" and "cherry-pick: flaky test tweak". CI queued.

kevin: @ajay once CI passes, do a quick perf check on canary (5m) and ping when clear. If any anomalies, we hold.

ajay: CI green for both. Perf check: 1-2% CPU delta on inference runtime for 512 tokens (within noise). Canary deploy prepping.

maria: Merging now. Merging order: #2330 first (test tweak), then #2323 (fix). Will push tag 1.9.5-rc1 after merge.

devops-bot: Merge pipeline triggered by maria — jobs: unit-tests, build-image, publish-artifact.

maria: Merged both at 11:16 PT. Tag pushed: `v1.9.5-rc1` -> release/1.9.x-hotpatch. Changelog draft: "fix: tokenization edge case producing duplicate tokens leading to embedding duplicates (regression from 1.9.4). Low risk."

sara: Changelog blurb approved. Short note for support: "patch 1.9.5 fixes a tokenization regression causing duplicate tokens in embeddings — customers may see higher duplication in near-duplicate detection." Adding to release notes.

kevin: Starting canary rollout. Command: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=registry/redwood/inference:1.9.5-rc1` then `kubectl rollout status`. Watch logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --tail=200`

devops-bot: Deploy job started by kevin — job id 9876. Canary target: 5% traffic for 10 minutes.

ajay: Canary smoke passed at +7m, no errors in token pipeline. Latency stable. CPU +1%. No new OOMs.

oliver: Observability: tokenization error-rate reduced to 0 (was ~0.8%). Traces show canonical path hit. Monitoring shows no downstream regressions.

eng-sre-bot: Canary OK. No alert triggers. Proceed to gradual rollout to 30% then full after 20m unless issues.

kevin: Rolling to 30%. Notifying support/sales for customer-impact note. @sara please publish release note when fully rolled.

sara: Will publish after full rollout. Draft is up in DOCS: https://docs.redwood/papers/1.9.5-release-notes.md

ajay: Full rollout at 11:46 PT completed. Post-rollout smoke: all green after 12m.

kevin: Cutoff reached. Marking 1.9.5 released. Minimal diff, no feature changes, rollback safe. :shipit: :thumbsup:

maria: Nice work everyone. Follow-up: open a ticket to add a specific unit test for the token-case and add a short e2e prompt test to catch regressions.

kevin: Filing follow-up ticket now. Tagging owners. Thanks all.

sara: Release note published and sent to #customer-updates. Notifying support.

maria: closing thread — will add PR links to changelog entry for traceability.

kevin: Thanks. If any customer reports slip through, escalate to me and oliver.

(Reaction annotations removed for export)
